verdict.rationale: Klaviyo supports building automated flows triggered by events (e.g., 'set up flows based on Klaviyo events to send out branded notifications') and general automation building is confirmed across plans. However, evidence doesn't show AI-native rule authoring beyond standard flow-builder UI or API-driven automation creation with explicit event-trigger logic exposed to an AI agent. Missing for 10: detailed API/webhook documentation for defining event-triggered rules programmatically, evidence of AI/agent-driven rule creation via MCP or API, and independent validation of automation depth.
